content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Shoes off, phone down, eyes up. The bamboo sways like it's keeping a secret."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Tentative usually means a dentist, but this market is worth one message. Graze the stalls, not the crowds."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Fox statues and vermilion gates, best before the crowds find their feet."},{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"The wooden stage hangs over the hillside like a dare."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A canal-side stroll where the blossoms do the talking."},{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"The silver pavilion keeps its shine in the moss and sand."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Gold leaf on water, and the crowd knows it. Go early, stand still, let it do the talking."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Nightingale floors squeak on purpose. Walk slowly and the castle tells on everyone else."},{"poi_id":"p16","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Temple food that treats vegetables like the main event, not the apology."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The garden is the real sermon here. Sit a minute before the pond."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Old wooden facades and the soft shuffle of Gion waking up for the evening."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Tofu done with the care most places save for poetry."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Lanterns, narrow stone, and the kind of night that makes you walk slower."}]}
Soft Gion landing, hills and gates, gold and castle, bamboo and museum — every must-do in, shoes off, phone down, eyes up.
